config.sql: WITH current_disposition AS (SELECT $1::uuid AS hold_id, $2::timestamptz AS decided_at, $3::uuid AS id), hold_context AS (SELECT jsonb_build_object('material', m.name, 'weight_kg', rl.quantity::text, 'quantity_kg', rl.quantity::text, 'weight_tolerance_kg', m.weight_tolerance_kg::text) AS hold FROM current_disposition c JOIN quality_holds q ON q.id = c.hold_id JOIN receipt_lines rl ON rl.id = q.line_id JOIN materials m ON m.id = rl.material_id), prior_history AS (SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('decision', d.decision) ORDER BY d.decided_at, d.id) FILTER (WHERE d.id IS NOT NULL), '[]'::jsonb) AS history FROM current_disposition c LEFT JOIN dispositions d ON d.hold_id = c.hold_id AND (d.decided_at < c.decided_at OR (d.decided_at = c.decided_at AND d.id < c.id))) SELECT hold_context.hold, prior_history.history FROM hold_context CROSS JOIN prior_history

WITH input AS (SELECT $1::jsonb AS result, $2::uuid AS disposition_id), inserted AS (INSERT INTO disposition_reviews (tenant_id, disposition_id, recommendation, confidence, matched) SELECT current_setting('app.tenant', true), disposition_id, result->>'recommendation', result->>'confidence', (result->>'matched')::boolean FROM input ON CONFLICT (tenant_id, disposition_id) DO NOTHING RETURNING id, disposition_id, recommendation, confidence, matched), read_back AS (SELECT r.id, r.disposition_id, r.recommendation, r.confidence, r.matched FROM disposition_reviews r JOIN input i ON r.disposition_id = i.disposition_id) SELECT id::text AS id, disposition_id::text AS disposition_id, recommendation, confidence, matched FROM inserted UNION ALL SELECT id::text, disposition_id::text, recommendation, confidence, matched FROM read_back WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM inserted)
